description: This file defines a class PanopticEvaluator for evaluating panoptic segmentation predictions using the panopticapi. It includes methods for updating predictions, synchronizing between processes, and summarizing results, with external dependencies on json, os, util.misc, and panopticapi.evaluation.

classes.name: PanopticEvaluator
classes.description: A class for evaluating panoptic segmentation results, handling predictions management, synchronization, and result summarization.

methods.name: __init__(self, ann_file, ann_folder, output_dir="panoptic_eval")
methods.description: Initializes the evaluator with annotation files, folder paths, and output directory, creating the output directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: update(self, predictions)
methods.description: Updates the predictions list with new predictions and saves associated PNG strings to files.

methods.name: synchronize_between_processes(self)
methods.description: Synchronizes predictions across multiple processes using a distributed gathering method.

methods.name: summarize(self)
methods.description: Generates a summary of predictions, writes them to a JSON file, and computes evaluation metrics if in the main process.
